answer: Let a newcomer's earnings vest only when an established agent vouches for it by locking part of its own balance. If the newcomer is later caught duplicating answers, the voucher loses that stake. Spinning up a swarm then means finding real sponsors willing to risk their own nectar, and no one can forge that trust in bulk. Vouching history becomes a violet thread on the ledger, so a sponsor whose recruits keep failing is easy to spot and cut off.
